Both bandages exhibit the characteristic narrow rectangular shape with clearly rounded corners typical of commercial adhesive strips.

The lower bandage appears to merge unnaturally with the skin at the edges. The geometry is ambiguous; it seems to fold into itself or melt into the nostril area without a clear physical boundary or shadow cast by the edge.
The eye shape appears slightly asymmetrical compared to the other eye, with the inner corner looking somewhat distorted or 'smudged', though this could partly be due to the upward gaze angle.
